images.prompt: Create one premium travel website hero, wide landscape 16:9, photorealistic editorial illustration of El Junco lagoon in the green volcanic highlands of San Cristobal, Galapagos, Ecuador. A small roughly circular freshwater crater lake filling a low gently rounded basin, ringed by dense green grasses, sedges, low shrubs and fern vegetation. View from the low rim path looking across still dark blue-green water, softly misty highland sky with one shaft of warm morning sunlight, modest rolling island hills beyond. One or two distant frigatebirds gliding small in scale above the lagoon, subtle dirt walking trail at edge. No towering snow mountains, no huge caldera cliffs, no buildings or docks, no sea inlet, no palm jungle. Faithful serene highland atmosphere, place subject to right leaving clean natural space on left for title, no text, watermark or collage.
